hello_world.name: hello_world
hello_world.notes: This is the default template provided by WhatsApp. Use this for re-engaging users outside the 24h window.

route_notification.name: route_notification
route_notification.description: Notify user when their route is ready
route_notification.example: Your route from {{1}} to {{2}} is ready! Total distance: {{3}}
route_notification.notes: This template needs to be created and approved in Meta Business Manager before use.

route_error.name: route_error
route_error.description: Notify user about route optimization error
route_error.example: We couldn't optimize your route. Error: {{1}}. Please try again.
route_error.notes: This template needs to be created and approved in Meta Business Manager before use.
